b'# tinydl

A simple command-line download utility.

## Usage

```bash
python -m app.cli [OPTIONS] URL
```

## Command Line Options

- **URL** (positional argument)  
  What to download.

- **-o, --output FILE**  
  File to write (default: stdout).

- **-q, --quiet**  
  No progress output.

## Examples

Download to stdout:
```bash
python -m app.cli https://example.com/file.txt
```

Download to a file:
```bash
python -m app.cli -o output.txt https://example.com/file.txt
```

Quiet mode (no progress output):
```bash
python -m app.cli -q https://example.com/file.txt
```
'
